title: eraseURLs
summary: Erase HTTP and HTTPS URLs from text and web-address tokens from tokenized documents.

gpu_support.notes: The documented inputs are host text and tokenizedDocument values. Resident numeric values reject before provider access.

description: `eraseURLs` erases HTTP and HTTPS URLs from documented text containers. Starting with the R2026a compatibility target, it also accepts tokenizedDocument input and removes tokens whose type is `web-address`.
behaviors: `newStr = eraseURLs(str)` accepts a string array, character vector, or cell array of character vectors and returns the same documented container type.
`newDocuments = eraseURLs(documents)` removes web-address tokens and preserves the document shape and remaining explicit token type metadata supported by RunMat's object model.
URL matching is case-insensitive for the HTTP and HTTPS schemes.
All integer and logical inputs are invalid; no numeric-to-text conversion occurs.
Multirow character matrices and cells containing strings or nested cells are broader RunMat-only forms with independent compatibility gates.
RunMat has no resident text storage or eraseURLs provider kernel, so invalid resident numeric values reject without gathering.

examples.input:
str = "For more information, see https://www.mathworks.com";
newStr = eraseURLs(str)

documents = tokenizedDocument("Visit https://example.com now");
newDocuments = eraseURLs(documents)
examples.output: The resulting document contains the tokens `Visit` and `now`.

faqs.question: When did tokenizedDocument support become part of the compatibility target?
faqs.answer: MathWorks added tokenizedDocument input to eraseURLs in R2026a, so it is part of RunMat's pinned current compatibility surface.

faqs.question: Does eraseURLs remove a bare www address?
faqs.answer: The documented surface specifies HTTP and HTTPS URLs. RunMat does not advertise bare `www.` matching as MATLAB-compatible behavior.

example.output: The result preserves the documented text container type or returns tokenized documents.

points: `str` is a string array, character vector, or cell array of character vectors.
The tokenizedDocument form removes tokens classified as `web-address`.

gpu_residency: Host-only text processing; no provider hook or resident text representation.
